arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# January 1980 and February 1980 surplus/deficit values (in millions)
jan_1980 = -4559
feb_1980 = -9346

# Calculate the change
change = feb_1980 - jan_1980
print(f'Change: {change}')

# Calculate absolute percentage change (relative to January 1980)
# Using absolute value of January for the denominator since we're measuring magnitude of change
pct_change = (change / abs(jan_1980)) * 100
print(f'Percentage change: {pct_change}')

# Round to nearest hundredths
print(f'Rounded: {round(pct_change, 2)}')
"
